nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to 'LiberT' in the FixedSupplyToken constructor.
Token name string, set to 'LiberT' in the FixedSupplyToken constructor.
Token decimals, set to 0 in the FixedSupplyToken constructor.
Internal fixed token supply of 108000000 assigned to owner at deployment.
Mapping of token holder balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowances mapping owner => spender => amount, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner and resets newOwner.
FixedSupplyToken constructor: sets metadata, mints entire supply to owner and emits Transfer.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View returning the token balance of a given account.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient after an inline balance/overflow check.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' by decrementing balance and allowance without any allowance sufficiency check.
View returning remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets an allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval while allowance state is already written.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls an arbitrary ERC20 contract's transfer for the owner.
SafeMath add with overflow require.
SafeMath sub with underflow require.
SafeMath mul with overflow require.
SafeMath div with division-by-zero require.
msg.sender controls authorization checks and is used as the balance/allowance key in state-mutating functions.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state is written inside approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied contract.
Raw addition balances[to] + tokens used in the inline overflow guard of transfer.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership; written into newOwner state.
Parameter 'to' of transfer; recipient balance key.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer; amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of approve; allowance key.

Parameter 'to' of transferFrom; destination balance key.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom; amount moved.

Parameter 'spender' of allowance; inner allowance key.

Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall; arbitrary bytes forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token; attacker-influenced external contract address.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token; amount forwarded to the external token.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf; balance lookup key.
Parameter 'a' of SafeMath.add.
Parameter 'b' of SafeMath.add.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorize the ownership handover.
transfer reads and decrements balances[msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable.
'to' parameter is used as the recipient key in balances.
'tokens' parameter determines the amount subtracted and added.
'spender' parameter is the inner allowance key in approve.
'from' parameter is the source balance and allowance key.
'to' parameter is the destination balance key in transferFrom.
'tokens' parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
'tokenOwner' parameter is the outer key in the allowance lookup.
'spender' parameter is the inner key in the allowance lookup.
'spender' parameter is the allowance key and the target contract of the external call.
'tokens' parameter is written to allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
'tokenAddress' parameter selects the external contract that is called.
'tokens' parameter is forwarded as the amount to the external transfer call.
'tokenOwner' parameter keys the balances mapping in balanceOf.
SafeMath.add operand 'a' is summed into local c.
SafeMath.add operand 'b' is summed into local c.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both parties.
Raw balances[to] + tokens addition is used as the overflow guard in transfer.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender] without an allowance check.
approve writes the allowed mapping for the caller and spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external callback.
The external receiveApproval call is executed inside approveAndCall after state is written.
The external ERC20 transfer call is executed inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The spender contract's receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall while the allowance write is already committed.
The external callback can re-enter transferFrom and spend allowances before the caller's flow completes.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during the external transfer.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the new owner candidate into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Token constructor assigns the entire supply to balances[owner].
Token constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and balances[address(0)].
SafeMath.add stores the result in local c before returning.
SafeMath.sub stores the result in local c before returning.
SafeMath.mul stores the result in local c before returning.
SafeMath.div stores the result in local c before returning.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter exists only to feed the transferOwnership state write and has no standalone semantic role.
The 'to' parameter is a transient recipient key used only inside transfer.
The 'tokens' parameter is a transient amount used only inside transfer.
The 'spender' parameter is a transient allowance key used only inside approve.
The 'from' parameter is a transient source key used only inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is a transient destination key used only inside transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is a transient amount used only inside transferFrom.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is a transient lookup key used only inside allowance.
The 'spender' parameter is a transient lookup key used only inside allowance.
The 'spender' parameter is consumed only by approveAndCall as allowance key and call target.
The 'tokens' parameter is consumed only by approveAndCall for the allowance write and callback.
The 'data' parameter is consumed only by approveAndCall when calling receiveApproval.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter is consumed only by transferAnyERC20Token as the external call target.
The 'tokens' parameter is consumed only by transferAnyERC20Token as the forwarded amount.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is a transient lookup key used only inside balanceOf.
SafeMath.add operand a is a transient utility input of the library function.
SafeMath.add operand b is a transient utility input of the library function.
Local c in SafeMath.add is the direct return value of that stateless function.
Local c in SafeMath.sub is the direct return value of that stateless function.
Local c in SafeMath.mul is the direct return value of that stateless function.
Local c in SafeMath.div is the direct return value of that stateless function.
